interpretationDecisions.decision: The heavy-Knee, OD-Knee, back-turn b.MK, forward-held OD back-grab and normal-throw knockdowns are separate prerequisites. Listed follow-up commands/costs begin afterward. +29/+27/+33/+42/+7/+6/+5 are source advantage readings, not invented wait instructions.

Live cyan/light, yellow/medium and red/heavy glyphs and animation govern strength. The 623HP overlay in one back-medium follow-up is contradicted by the actual heavy-kick Knee. Only the demonstrated ender is authored from lines listing normal/OD/Super alternatives.

The far-light route performs cr.MP despite the shortened MP overlay. The cash-out first Rush link performs cr.HP, not the printed standing-MP alternative; actual direction, strength, animation and damage govern both recipes.

The corner-heavy-Knee and OD-Knee dash shimmies both perform two standing medium punches before heavy Knee; neutral yellow-punch glyphs, animation and damage verify the pair. The held-heavy reversal routes include the actual blocked b.MK opener and backward movement before Ryu OD uppercut misses. That context is not omitted or represented as an armor claim.

The heavy-Chop turn-around is an actual prerequisite for Power Drop and its OD extensions. The forward-held OD extension and additional-PP Level-2 throw follow-up are different branches. Ambiguous special English names remain command-labeled.

The Prowler leap evades the recorded Ryu OD uppercut by crossing over. The OD-back-grab jump includes j.HK before landing guard, and only its Ryu OD block is claimed safe. No universal or on-reaction reversal claim is inferred.

Only Brian’s actual grounded 623LK jump interception gets Anti-air. Its subsequent green wake-up approach is not part of the anti-air juggle. Normal blocked-DI wall crush, counter-DI crumple, and Burnout stun are distinct. Near-corner Level-2 carry starts Midscreen and ends in the corner.

The light-confirm two-DRC/Level-3 route visibly spends six Drive into Burnout and all three Super bars; it receives Cash-out. Other Super use alone does not receive that goal. OD/Rush prerequisites outside setup loops retain separate costs.
